items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: I remember one night, he come and we had a four piece job... So we start the play.

ctx.x: Do you remember who any of the outstanding bass players were?
No. Fanats. The Italian fella by the name of Fanats. Mario. Mario Fanats. He was about the best. Uh huh.
We know his sons. You do?
